  </div><div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;"> <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">If securities are registered pursuant to Section 12(b) of the Act, indicate by check mark whether the financial statements of the registrant included in the filing reflect the correction of an error to previously issued financial statements. </span><ix:nonNumeric contextRef="c0" format="ixt-sec:boolballotbox" name="dei:DocumentFinStmtErrorCorrectionFlag" id="ixv-322"><span style="font-family: Segoe UI Symbol; font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#9744;</span></ix:nonNumeric> </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>

   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Indicate by check mark whether any of those error corrections are restatements that required a recovery analysis of incentive-based compensation received by any of the registrant&#8217;s executive officers during the relevant recovery period pursuant to &#167;240.10D-1(b). </span><span style="font-family: Segoe UI Symbol; font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#9744;</span>

  </div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center">1</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div style="text-align: center; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">INTRODUCTION</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Prior to the consummation of our initial public offering in December 2024, we completed a series of reorganization transactions (the &#8220;Reorganization&#8221;). Unless otherwise indicated or context otherwise requires in this Annual Report on Form 10-K (this &#8220;Form 10-K&#8221;), all references in this Form 10-K to the &#8220;Company,&#8221; &#8220;Anteris,&#8221; &#8220;Anteris</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">,&#8221; &#8220;we,&#8221; &#8220;us&#8221; and &#8220;our&#8221; refer to Anteris Technologies Pty Ltd (&#8220;ATPL&#8221;, formerly Anteris Technologies Ltd) prior to the Reorganization and Anteris Technologies Global Corp. (&#8220;ATGC&#8221;) after the Reorganization, and for purposes of this Form 10-K:</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> anti-calcification tissue&#8221; refers to the tissue produced by the ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue engineering process, which transforms xenograft tissue (bovine heart tissue) into a durable bioscaffold which Anteris uses in its DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV to mimic human tissue in aortic valve replacement.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Aldehydes&#8221; refers to organic compounds.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Aortic stenosis&#8221; refers to the narrowing of the aortic valve restricting the flow of blood from the left ventricle (lower chamber of the heart) to the aorta (main artery).</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Bioscaffold&#8221; refers to a durable structure engineered from biological material.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Coaptation&#8221; refers to the portion of the leaflets that touch when the aortic valve is in the closed position.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;Delivery System&#8221; refers to the balloon expandable system which provides controlled deployment and accurate placement of the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV, designed to achieve precise alignment with the heart&#8217;s native commissures to achieve ideal valve positioning.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Commissure alignment&#8221; refers to the position of the transcatheter aortic valve replacement leaflets in line with the anatomical orientation of the recipient&#8217;s native valve leaflets.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Commissures&#8221; refers to where the valve leaflets are attached to the aortic wall inside the aortic sinus of Valsalva.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Cytotoxicity&#8221; refers to toxicity to cells.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Doppler velocity index&#8221; and &#8220;DVI&#8221; refer to the index that expresses the EOA as a proportion of valve area, with DVI representing the physical ratio of a patient&#8217;s aortic valve area to the left ventricular outflow tract area. A higher DVI indicates improved blood flow through the aortic valve. DVI is independent of the flow state (like gradient) and diameter (like EOA).</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV&#8221; refers to a transcatheter heart valve (&#8220;THV&#8221;) developed by Anteris. It is a novel, biomimetic (meaning human-like) valve made from a single-piece of native-shaped ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue and is used for the treatment of aortic stenosis. The DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV (new aortic valve) is placed within the diseased aortic valve via a minimally invasive procedure.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Effective orifice area&#8221; and &#8220;EOA&#8221; refer to the smallest cross-sectional area of the aortic valve opening that is available for blood flow. A larger EOA reduces the work the left ventricle (heart chamber) must do to pump blood through the valve. Patients with severe aortic stenosis typically have an EOA of &#8804; 1 cm</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">2</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Exercise capacity&#8221; refers to a measure of a patient&#8217;s exercise ability, measured in clinical trials by a six minute walk test (&#8220;6MWT&#8221;), which scores a person on the distance they can cover in six minutes of walking.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Flow displacement&#8221; and &#8220;FD&#8221; refer to a marker of flow eccentricity in the ascending aortic root. Flow in the ascending aortic root is mainly laminar with a flow displacement ranging from 6&#8201;&#8211;&#8201;15% only. A higher degree of FD reflects abnormal turbulent flow.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Flow reversal ratio&#8221; or &#8220;FRR&#8221; is calculated at peak systole in the ascending aorta. At this point there should be almost no backward flow, and any backward flow is considered abnormal. FRR represents the ratio of backward and forward flow at peak systole.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Hemodynamics&#8221; refers to how blood flows through the blood vessels.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="clear: both;">&#160;</div><div>

  </div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">1</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Laminar flow&#8221; refers to a smooth, streamlined flow of blood. In a healthy heart, aortic flow is predominantly laminar during systole (when the left ventricle contracts and pumps blood into the aorta). Abnormal aortic flow is associated with turbulence, which can increase the risk of morbidity and increase the stress on the valve leaflets leading to increased wear and tear and subsequent structural valve deterioration.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Mean pressure gradient&#8221; and &#8220;MPG&#8221; refer to the average pressure across the aortic valve between the left ventricle and aorta. Patients with severe aortic stenosis have MPG &#8805; 40 mmHg. Post-TAVR MPG is expected to decrease, which indicates that the left ventricle is not working as hard to pump blood through the aortic valve.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Transcatheter aortic valve replacement&#8221; or &#8220;TAVR&#8221; refer to a minimally invasive procedure for the treatment of aortic stenosis. A new aortic valve is placed inside the diseased valve, meaning the old, damaged valve is not removed.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;ViV&#8221; refers to valve-in-valve.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8220;Xenograft&#8221; refers to a tissue that is derived from a species that is different from the recipient of the specimen, meaning tissue from animal species.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="clear: both;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">&#160;</span>
  </div><div>

  </div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">2</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div style="text-align: center; margin-left: 0.2pt;">

  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">

Forward-looking statements, which are subject to risks, include, but are not limited to, statements about:</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">our current and future research and development (&#8220;R&amp;D&#8221;) activities, including clinical testing and manufacturing and related costs and timing&#894;</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">our product development and business strategy, including the potential size of the markets for our products and future development and/or expansion of our products in our markets&#894;</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>

     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Obtaining and maintaining our patent protection depends on compliance with various procedural, document submission, fee payment and other requirements imposed by governmental patent agencies, and our patent protection could be reduced or eliminated for non-compliance with these requirements.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Any difficulty with protecting our intellectual property could diminish the value of our intellectual property rights in the relevant jurisdiction.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>

    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Medtronic plc (&#8220;Medtronic&#8221;) beneficially owns a significant equity interest in us and its interests may conflict with our or your interests.</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;

     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">We will require substantial additional future financing and, until commercialization of our products, our cash burn in future periods may be higher than anticipated. We may be unable to raise sufficient capital in future financings, including to account for unanticipated cash burn, which could have a material impact on our R&amp;D programs or commercialization of our products.</span>

<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div style="text-align: center;">
   <a id="PART_I" title="PART I"></a><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">PART I</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -54pt; padding-left: 54pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 54.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">Item 1</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <a id="Business" title="Business"></a><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">Business</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">Overview</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">Anteris is a structural heart company dedicated to revolutionizing cardiac care by pioneering science-driven and measurable advancements to restore heart valve patients to healthy function. Our lead product, the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV System, was designed in collaboration with the world&#8217;s leading interventional cardiologists and cardiac surgeons to treat aortic stenosis &#8212; a potentially life-threatening condition resulting from a narrowing of the aortic valve. The balloon-expandable DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV is the first biomimetic valve, which is shaped to mimic the performance of a healthy human aortic valve and aims to replicate normal aortic blood flow. Our DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV System consists of a single-piece, biomimetic valve made with our proprietary ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> tissue-enhancing technology and deployed with our balloon expandable ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> Delivery System. ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> is our proprietary anti-calcification tissue shaping technology that is designed to reengineer xenograft tissue into a pure, single-piece collagen bioscaffold. Our patented ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> tissue has been clinically demonstrated to be calcium free for up to 10 years post-procedure, according to </span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20; font-style: italic;">Performance of the ADAPT-Treated CardioCel</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20; font-style: italic;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20; font-style: italic;"> Scaffold in Pediatric Patients With Congenital Cardiac Anomalies: Medium to Long-Term Outcomes</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">, published by William Neethling et. al., and has been distributed for use in over 55,000 patients globally in other indications. Our balloon expandable ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> Delivery System, which was developed in consultation with physicians, is designed to provide precise alignment with the heart&#8217;s native commissures to achieve accurate placement of the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV. As of December 2025, more than 130 patients have been implanted with the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV worldwide.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">Aortic stenosis is one of the most common and serious valvular heart diseases. It is fatal in approximately 50% of patients if left untreated after two years, and no pharmacotherapy is available to treat this disease. Aortic stenosis causes a narrowing of the heart&#8217;s aortic valve, which reduces or blocks the amount of blood flowing from the heart to the body&#8217;s largest artery, the aorta, and from there to the rest of the body. Minimally-invasive transcatheter aortic valve replacement (&#8220;TAVR&#8221;), which the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (&#8220;FDA&#8221;) initially approved in 2011 for high surgical risk patients, has emerged as an alternative to open-heart surgery. In 2019, the FDA also approved TAVR for use in low-risk surgical patients. These low-risk surgical patients are often younger persons within the geriatric population that require heart valves with longer durability and pre-disease hemodynamics for an improved quality of life. More generally, patients with aortic valve stenosis are now being diagnosed at a younger age. Yet, according to a publication in The Journal of American Medical Association, only 15-20% of severe aortic stenosis cases are treated today.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>

  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="color: rgb(35, 31, 32);">While previous generations of TAVRs were designed for older, high risk patients, our DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="color: rgb(35, 31, 32);"> THV System is designed to be a solution for all patients, including both older, younger and less-active patients. Our first in class DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="color: rgb(35, 31, 32);"> THV is a single-piece valve with a novel, biomimetic design that aims to replicate the normal blood flow of a healthy human aortic valve as compared to traditional three-piece aortic valves. The <span style="letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 48px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">DurAVR</span><sup style="letter-spacing: normal; text-indent: 48px; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial; font-size: 7pt;">&#174;</sup> THV System has shown restoration of laminar flow similar to individuals with a healthy aortic valve, and early left ventricular reverse remodeling compared with pre-TAVR and similar to healthy controls.</span>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">In a pooled analysis of 100 patients derived from our ongoing First-In-Human (&#8220;FIH&#8221;) study (referred to as the &#8220;EMBARK&#8221; study) and early feasibility studies (&#8220;EFS&#8221;) conducted in the United States and Europe, the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV demonstrated single digit mean gradients, large effective orifice areas (&#8220;EOAs&#8221;), no moderate or severe paravalvular leaks and no valve related mortality, with 97% freedom from prosthesis-patient mismatch (&#8220;PPM&#8221;). These results were observed in a cohort of small annuli patients similar to the one reported in the SMall Annuli Randomized To Evolut&#8482; or SAPIEN&#8482; Trial (&#8220;SMART&#8221;), a prospective, multicenter, randomized controlled trial evaluating transcatheter aortic valve performance in patients with small aortic annuli. PPM affects a significant proportion of TAVR patients, particularly patients with a small aortic annulus and has been associated with impaired long-term survival following surgical aortic valve replacement (&#8220;SAVR&#8221;). </span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">In addition, our DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV has been developed with the aim to increase durability and last longer than traditional three-piece designs through the use of our ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> anti-calcification tissue including a molded single-piece of tissue designed to mimic the performance of a pre-disease human aortic valve, which we believe can result in improved hemodynamics as compared to traditional three-piece designs. These designs and features cumulatively aim to provide a better quality of life as compared to the current standard of care associated with traditional three-piece designs. We intend to test these features in the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV randomized, global pivotal study (the &#8220;PARADIGM Trial&#8221;).</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>


  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="color: rgb(35, 31, 32);">The PARADIGM Trial is a prospective, randomized, controlled multicenter, international study wherein subjects are randomized to receive either a TAVR using the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="color: rgb(35, 31, 32);"> THV or TAVR using a commercially available and approved THV in an &#8216;All Comers Randomized Cohort.&#8217; The primary end point of the PARADIGM Trial is a composite of all-cause mortality, all stroke and cardiovascular hospitalizations at 1-year post-procedure, according to Valve Academic Research Consortium&#8209;3 (&#8220;VARC-3&#8221;), a globally accepted consensus framework that standardizes clinical endpoint definitions for aortic valve clinical research. The endpoint will be evaluated as a non-inferiority analysis. We anticipate that the subjects will include a broad array of risk profiles. Subjects with a failed surgical bioprosthesis in need of a ViV TAVR are enrolled in a separate parallel registry.&#160;</span></div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">&#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">6</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">In 2025, we advanced regulatory activities in Europe, with the goal of securing approval to commence the PARADIGM Trial in a number of European countries. In October 2025, we secured the first European regulatory approval in Denmark and subsequently enrolled and treated the first patients marking the formal initiation of the PARADIGM Trial. In November 2025, we also received Investigational Device Exemption (&#8220;IDE&#8221;) approval from the FDA for the PARADIGM Trial. The FDA granted a staged approval authorizing enrollment of the first 200 patients. We may request authorization to expand enrollment for the remaining subjects through an IDE supplement. Throughout the year, our cross&#8209;functional teams continued to execute site activation, regulatory preparation, and operational readiness activities in anticipation of regulatory approval in each participating country.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">We expect the data from the PARADIGM Trial could provide the clinical evidence required for regulators to approve commercialization. This includes premarket approval that is required for commercialization of the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #231F20;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;"> THV System in the United States and CE Mark approval in Europe.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">We continued strengthening our operational infrastructure during the year, advancing quality management system buildout to support upcoming clinical activities and future ISO 13485 certification. Key quality procedures and standard operating documents were released to establish the framework for a mature, compliant system and mitigate audit risk. In parallel, manufacturing scale-up activities progressed, including cross-training of inspection personnel, expansion of clean room capacity, and ongoing process development initiatives to ensure robust, high-yield production in line with projected demand.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">We are a development stage company and have incurred net losses each year since operation, however, we believe that we have significant growth potential in a large, underpenetrated and growing TAVR market. Since the inception of the TAVR procedure, the annual volume of TAVR procedures in the United States has increased significantly year-over-year, with an estimated 73,000 patients having undergone a TAVR procedure in the United States in 2019 according to the STS/ACC TVT Registry. According to FMI, a market research firm, the total global market opportunity for TAVR in relation to severe aortic stenosis and in relation to ViV procedures is expected to reach $9.9 billion and $2.5 billion, respectively, in 2028.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.1pt; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">Our innovation-focused R&amp;D practice is driven by rapid technological advancement and significant input from leading interventional cardiologists and cardiac surgeons. As a company that is primarily in the development phase, we currently generate small amounts of revenue and income which are insufficient to cover our investment in research, development and operational activities resulting in recurring net operating losses, incurred since inception. We, like other development stage medical device companies, experience challenges in implementing our business strategy due to limited resources and a smaller capital base as we prioritize product development, minimize the period to the commencement of commercial sales, ensure our focus on quality as well as scale our operations. The development and commercialization of new medical devices is highly competitive. Those competitors may have substantial market share, substantially greater capital resources and established relationships with the structural heart community, potentially creating barriers to adoption of our technology. Our success will partly be based on our ability to educate the market about the benefits of our disruptive technology including current unmet clinical needs compared to commercially available devices as well as how we plan to capture market share post commercialization.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.7pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.3pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">We are dedicated to developing technological enhancements and new indications for existing products, and less invasive and novel technologies to address unmet patient needs in structural heart disease. That dedication leads to our initiation and participation in clinical trials that seek to prove our pipeline is safe and effective as the demand for clinical and economic evidence remains high.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.1pt; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.9pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.1pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #231F20;">From time to time, we enter into strategic agreements aimed at enhancing our business operations and profitability. For example, in April 2023, we invested in and entered into a development agreement (the &#8220;Development Agreement&#8221;) with, v2vmedtech, inc. (&#8220;v2vmedtech&#8221;), which develops an innovative heart valve repair device for the minimally invasive treatment of mitral and tricuspid valve regurgitation.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">Market Opportunity</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.9pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.1pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">According to the World Bank, the total population over 65 in the United States and the European Union was approximately 173.6 million as of 2024. According to FMI, the total global market opportunity for TAVR in relation to severe aortic stenosis and in relation to ViV procedures is expected to reach $9.9 billion and $2.5 billion, respectively, in 2028. The key specific markets that our Company is initially targeting are North America and Europe due to these markets accounting for the majority of the above global opportunity. FMI indicated that the North American and European markets averaged 53% and 38% of the global market share, respectively, during the period 2016 to 2023. FMI forecasts that the market opportunity in relation to severe aortic stenosis for North America and Europe will reach $5.5 billion and $3.7 billion, respectively, in 2028&#894; and the market opportunity in relation to ViV procedures is forecast to reach $1.5 billion and $0.8 billion, respectively, in 2028. To calculate these future market values, FMI has relied on actual data from 2023 collated from a variety of published sources and key medical experts and applied a projected CAGR of 14.9% for the global market, 16.2% for the North American market, and 14.0% for the European market. A non-exhaustive list of factors that may impact these forecast calculations include key players&#8217; historic growth&#894; companies and manufacturers working together to develop new, affordable and timesaving technologies&#894; new product launches and approvals&#894; rising demand for THV replacement&#894; availability and cost of products&#894; growing investment in healthcare expenditure&#894; and increased regulatory focus on patient safety and reimbursement policies. In addition, we expect the TAVR market to benefit from general trends, including an aging population, earlier diagnosis of aortic stenosis, increased incidence of obesity and diabetes (which contribute to heart disease), as well as the broader patient populations&#8217; desire to pursue a more active lifestyle.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;</span>
  </div><div>

  </div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">7</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   Since the inception of the TAVR procedure, the annual volume of TAVR procedures in the United States has increased significantly year-over-year, with an estimate of nearly 100,000 patients having undergone a TAVR procedure in the United States in 2022 according to the TVT Registry. We believe that the rising geriatric population and the growing cardiovascular device market provides us with a clear business opportunity. The use of healthcare services is significantly higher among older people.
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV&#8217;s single-piece native shaped biomimetic design replicates the performance of a healthy human aortic valve and is designed to restore normal blood flow as compared to traditional three-piece transcatheter valves, either balloon expandable or self-expanding, which do not restore normal aortic flow. We believe this design, in combination with the ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue technology, has the potential to allow the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV to last longer than traditional three-piece aortic valves, which have multiple leaflets sewn together that may lead to compromised durability.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">Our Product Candidates</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.9pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.1pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV, which employs our ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> anti-calcification tissue and is deployed using our ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;Delivery System, is currently in clinical development.</span>

   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;"> Transcatheter Heart Valve System</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Our DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV is a novel transcatheter aortic valve designed in collaboration with the world&#8217;s leading interventional cardiologists and cardiac surgeons to treat symptomatic severe aortic stenosis &#8211; a potentially life-threatening condition resulting from the narrowing of the aortic valve. The balloon-expandable DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV is the first biomimetic valve, shaped to mimic the performance of a healthy human aortic valve and aims to replicate normal aortic blood flow. Our DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV is made using a single piece of molded bovine pericardial tissue treated with ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">, our patented anti-calcification tissue technology, sutured inside a cobalt-chromium frame. ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue, which is FDA-cleared, has been used clinically for over 10 years and distributed for use in over 55,000 patients worldwide. The DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;THV System is comprised of the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> valve, the ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue, and the balloon-expandable ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;Delivery System</span><span style="font-family: Helvetica; font-size: 10.0pt;">. </span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">These designs and features cumulatively aim to restore a better quality of life compared to the current standard of care associated with traditional three-piece designs. We intend to evaluate the safety and efficacy of the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV against commercially approved TAVR devices in the global pivotal PARADIGM Trial (NCT07194265).</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">The DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV has the following attributes:</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">it is the first transcatheter aortic valve to use a patented construction of a molded single-piece of bioengineered tissue (our ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> anti-calcification tissue with molded leaflets (see &#8220;</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;">ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;"> Anti-Calcification Tissue</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8221;))&#894;</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">it has fewer sutures and seams when compared with conventional valves, thereby preserving tissue integrity with the intent to reduce calcification risk to extend valve durability&#894;</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">it is uniquely shaped to emulate the performance of a healthy human valve and produce long leaflet coaptation, laminar flow and near-normal hemodynamics&#894;</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="clear: both;">&#160;</div><div>

  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">it has large open cells in the stent frame to facilitate coronary access&#894; and</span>
    </div>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 45pt; font-size: 10pt; clear: both;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: -27pt; text-align: justify; padding-left: 45pt;">
    <div style="float: left; width: 27.0pt; white-space: nowrap;">
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8226;</span>
    </div>
    <div>
     <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">it utilizes the ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> balloon expandable Delivery System (see &#8220;</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;">ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;"> Delivery System</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#8221;) for controlled deployment and accurate placement.</span>

<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="margin-left: 0.1pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">&#174;</sup><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">&#160;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">Anti-Calcification Tissue</span>
  </div><div>

  </div><div style="text-align: center;">

  &#160;</div><div style="text-align: center;">
   <img alt="" src="image03.gif" style="width: 231.78pt; height: 265.54pt;"/>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">The ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue engineering process is an anti-calcification preparation that transforms xenograft tissue (bovine pericardium) into durable bioscaffolds that are used to mimic human tissue for surgical repair in multiple settings, including aortic valve replacement. The outcome of the ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue engineering process is a novel, acellular, biostable and non-calcifying biomaterial.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">The ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174; </sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">tissue engineering process involves multiple steps to transform bovine pericardium into a durable bioprosthetic material. Bovine spongiform encephalopathy-free bovine pericardium is decellularized to remove all cellular antigens that initiate an immune response. The material is then crosslinked to enable maintenance and stabilization of strength and elasticity to improve mechanical resistance. The cytotoxicity is further reduced using detoxification and sterilization processes and anti-calcification methodology to remove and bind aldehydes and enable safe storage in a non-glutaraldehyde solution. Post-implantation, ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue provides a scaffold for cell migration to create the optimal environment. Migrated cells can stimulate site-specific remodeling and repair and enable the formation of new blood vessels.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Our proprietary ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue has been clinically demonstrated to be calcium-free for up to 10 years post-procedure, according to </span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;">Performance of the ADAPT-Treated CardioCel</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;"> Scaffold in Pediatric Patients With Congenital Cardiac Anomalies: Medium to Long-Term Outcomes</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">, published by William Neethling et. al., and it has been distributed for use in over 55,000 patients globally in other indications. Our ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> balloon-expandable Delivery System, which was developed in consultation with physicians, is designed to provide precise alignment with the heart&#8217;s native commissures to achieve accurate placement of the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div>&#160;</div><div>

  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">To meet the need for a durable THV, made from ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> tissue scaffold, we have created the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV, which is a first in class, biomimetic single-piece valve with optimal hemodynamic and durability properties. Based on published clinical data in several peer-reviewed journals, including The Journal of Thoracic and Cardiovascular Surgery, the Expert Review of Medical Devices, and Interactive Cardiovascular and Thoracic Surgery, ADAPT</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> has been observed to offer potentially significant improvements compared with other widely available commercial processes adopted by healthcare providers, including with respect to bio-compatibility, durability, strength, pliability, functionality and controlled remodeling.</span>
  </div><div>&#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">9</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div>

  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold; font-style: italic;"> Delivery System</span>
  </div><div>

  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div style="text-align: center;">
   <img alt="" src="image04.gif" style="width: 162.02pt; height: 87.76pt;"/>
  </div><div style="margin-left: 36pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;</span>
  </div><div>

  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.9pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.1pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Our ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;Delivery System is a physician-developed balloon expandable delivery system that contains a reinforced steerable catheter for a precise deflection through the heart anatomy in a controlled manner to avoid damage to the aorta. This delivery system provides controlled deployment and accurate placement of our DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV. Our ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Delivery System is designed to achieve precise alignment with the heart&#8217;s native commissures to achieve ideal valve positioning.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.1pt; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;</div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: center;">
   <img alt="" src="image05.gif" style="width: 184.53pt; height: 189.78pt;"/>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; margin-left: 36pt; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 32.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 3.1pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;Within the ComASUR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;Delivery System, we have rotational control of the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> valve with the native commissures. This allows for commissure alignment, which is not achieved consistently in competitive delivery systems. Commissure alignment is important because it positions the transcatheter valve leaflets in line with the patient&#8217;s native anatomy, supporting optimal hemodynamics, facilitating future coronary access, and enabling consistent device performance. This feature positions the TAVR valve leaflets exactly in line with the anatomical orientation of the recipient&#8217;s native valve leaflets. We have a patent pending for this system.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;</span>

  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">&#160;</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">Clinical Results and Trials</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Over 130 patients have been successfully treated with the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174; </sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">THV, including de novo (first time) aortic stenosis cases, ViV patients and complex anatomies such as bicuspid aortic valve patients. We continue to expand the level of global experience and build the body of clinical evidence for the DurAVR</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">&#174;</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;"> THV System through our clinical development program, comprised of the ongoing EMBARK study, EFSs in the United States and European Union (the &#8220;U.S. EFS&#8221; and &#8220;EU EFS,&#8221; respectively) and the recently initiated global, pivotal PARADIGM Trial, in addition to compassionate use cases.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-align: justify; font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 36pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">The EMBARK study, initiated in November 2021 in Tbilisi, Georgia, has enrolled nine cohorts and demonstrated consistent device performance, favorable hemodynamic outcomes, and an acceptable safety profile through available follow-up periods. In addition, we enrolled 15 patients across four centers in our U.S. EFS, achieving 100% implant success with no mortality, disabling stroke, or life-threatening bleeding at 30 days. Our EU EFS enrolled 15 patients to further evaluate safety and ViV performance in a controlled setting. 30-day data from these studies were pooled and recently published in </span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-style: italic;">EuroIntervention</span><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">. This data demonstrates promising clinical and echocardiographic outcomes in patients with small aortic annuli, a population at greater risk for impaired valve hemodynamics. The overall technical success rate was high at 93% with no deaths, a low stroke rate (2%), single-digit gradients (8.2 mmHg), large EOAs (2.2 cm</span><sup style="font-size: 7.0pt; color: #000000;">2</sup><span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">), and low rate of moderate or greater prosthesis-patient mismatch (3%) through 30 days.</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div>&#160;</div><div>

  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt; color: rgb(0, 0, 0); text-indent: 50px; padding-left: 0px;"><span style="letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">Building on these clinical programs, in 2025 we initiated our PARADIGM Trial, a global, prospective, randomized, controlled, multicenter study comparing DurAVR</span><sup style="letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">&#174;&#160;</sup><span style="letter-spacing: normal; text-align: justify; text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;">THV to commercially available THVs. The PARADIGM Trial is designed to generate the clinical evidence necessary to support global regulatory approval. The first patients were enrolled in October 2025, and in November 2025, we announced that the FDA granted IDE approval for a staged enrollment for the first 200 patients in the PARADIGM Trial in the United States.</span></div><div>&#160;</div><div style="width: 100%; font-family: TimesNewRoman, &quot;Times New Roman&quot;, Times, Baskerville, Georgia, serif; font-size: 8pt; margin-top: 10px; margin-bottom: 10px; text-indent: 0px; font-weight: normal; font-style: normal; text-decoration: none;">
  <div style="text-align: center;">11</div>
  <div style="break-after: page;"><hr style="border: none; width: 100%; height: 2px; color: black; background-color: black;"/></div>
<div class="header override"><div style="clear: both; font-size: 8pt;"><i><a href="#TABLE_OF_CONTENTS">Table of Contents</a></i></div></div></div><div>


  </div><div>
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000; font-weight: bold;">Competition</span>
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="font-size: 10pt;">&#160;
  </div><div>
  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">We compete in the cardiovascular device market, and in particular the TAVR market. These markets are characterized by rapid change resulting from technological advances, innovations and scientific discoveries. Our products face a mix of competitors ranging from large manufacturers with multiple business lines to small manufacturers offering a limited selection of products. In addition, we face competition from providers of other medical therapies, such as pharmaceutical companies. Our primary competitors include Edwards Lifesciences Corporation and Medtronic. Currently, no competitor has a single-piece tissue TAVR commercially available or has publicly disclosed that a single-piece tissue TAVR is in development.</span>

  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; margin-left: 0.2pt; text-align: justify;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Major shifts in industry market share have occurred in connection with product corrective actions, physician advisories, safety alerts, results of clinical trials to support superiority claims, and publications about products, reflecting the importance of product quality, product efficacy and quality systems in the medical technology industry. In the current environment of managed care, economically motivated customers, consolidation among healthcare providers, increased competition, declining reimbursement rates, and national and provincial tender pricing, competitively priced product offerings are essential to our business. In order to compete effectively, we must continue to create or acquire advanced technology, incorporate this technology into proprietary products, obtain regulatory approvals in a timely manner, maintain high-quality manufacturing processes, and successfully market these products.</span>

United States federal registrations for trademarks can remain in force in perpetuity, provided the mark is still being used in commerce and the maintenance/renewal filings are made as required by the sixth year after registration, by the tenth year after registration, and every ten years thereafter.</span>

  </div><div style="text-indent: 35.8pt; text-align: justify; margin-left: 0.2pt;">
   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">In the category of prosthetic heart valve devices, we are the sole owner of eight active United States patents, seven pending United States patent applications, seven active Australian patents, three pending Australian patent applications, eight active patents in other countries, and 31 pending applications in other countries. These patents and pending applications are directed to features that are expected to provide competitive advantages such as: a novel process for production of calcification resistant cross-linked biomaterials for the prosthetic valve&#894; three-dimensional molded heart valve leaflets made of cross-linked biomaterial that mimic the performance of a native heart valve designed to provide enhanced performance characteristics such as low mean pressure gradient, low leaflet stress, large open area, high coaptation area and high duration in an open state, to name a few&#894; a prosthetic heart valve that has localized protective covering members that prevent direct contact between the valve and the stent frame to enhance the durability and longevity of the prosthetic valve when the valve is in an open state&#894; and attachment of the biomaterial valve to the stent frame in a novel manner that reduces stresses on the biomaterial of the prosthetic valve.</span>

These patents and pending applications are directed to features that are expected to provide competitive advantages such as: controllable and predictable commissural alignment&#894; a balloon folding technique that mitigates valve rotations during expansion&#894; a single-use valve crimping device&#894; and a delivery catheter hard stop member made of a braided metal material that provides improved trackability, effective expansion of the delivery sheath during advancement, and increased longitudinal compressive strength that serves to maintain the longitudinal position of the prosthetic heart valve on the balloon member.</span>

Pursuant to the v2v Agreements, we provide engineering, clinical, regulatory, marketing, and executive management resources, but excluding medical and chief medical officer services, in connection with v2vmedtech&#8217;s development of these valve repair devices. We are responsible for developing products and preparing regulatory filings and all costs and expenses incurred by us directly, related to the development of devices constitute development contributions under the v2v Agreements, for which we are solely responsible. These contributions are to be provided over five stages linked to key development and regulatory requirements for the device for transcatheter edge-to-edge repair of the mitral valve (&#8220;TEER Product&#8221;).</span>

   <span style="font-size: 10.0pt; color: #000000;">Stage 1 is the development of a preferred concept for the TEER Product, during which we will provide analytical, engineering and product development services for the TEER product, gather and document preliminary or critical product requirements, create product specifications, design at least one concept to meet that product specification, and provide initial prototypes. During this stage, v2vmedtech will also establish a separate medical advisory board (the &#8220;v2v Advisory Board&#8221;). Stage 1 concluded with a design review with non-Anteris members of v2vmedtech, prior to proceeding to Stage 2. The R&amp;D contributions (excluding general and administration expenses) paid by us under Stage 1 were $2.2 million.</span>

This stage included additional engineering and product development services to modify the preferred concept of the TEER Product at our sole discretion. Before we make a decision to advance to Stage 3, a design review with non-Anteris members of v2vmedtech will be conducted and their feedback will be considered. In addition, to advance to Stage 3, the TEER Product must meet all established criteria in our quality system. The R&amp;D contributions (excluding general and administration expenses) paid by us as set out in the Development Agreement under Stage 2 are expected to be $0.4 million to $0.8 million.</span>

The R&amp;D contributions (excluding general and administration expenses) paid by us as set out in the Development Agreement under Stage 3 are expected to be $0.8 million to $1.8 million.</span>

Approval from v2vmedtech&#8217;s Advisory Board may be required before proceeding to Stage 5. The R&amp;D contributions (excluding general and administration expenses) paid by us as set out in the Development Agreement under Stage 4 are expected to be $0.7 million to $1.6 million.</span>

The Harvey Supply Agreement expires in May 2026 but may be extended by mutual agreement between us and Harvey. If the Harvey Supply Agreement is not extended, Harvey will continue to supply us with bovine pericardia for an additional four months after the expiration of the Harvey Supply Agreement upon our request. We may terminate the Harvey Supply Agreement without cause upon 90 days written notice, and Harvey may terminate the Harvey Supply Agreement with 12 months written notice. Either us or Harvey may terminate the Harvey Supply Agreement for cause upon an uncured breach or a non-remediable breach.</span>
